messages:
Noah (Head of GTM): Quick follow-up from the all-hands: leadership asked to confirm the top three strategic priorities for next 12 months for our external comms. @Claire @Raj?
Claire (CEO): Priorities: 1) make inference predictable at scale (latency + cost), 2) expand Dedicated/Private for regulated customers, 3) build developer velocity with SDKs and eval tooling.
Zara (Product Marketing): For external comms, should we reorder language to lead with customer outcomes instead of technical features?
Raj (VP Product): Yes. Lead with outcomes: predictable economics, reliable latency, and operational controls. Then list features (rollouts, caching, routing) on product pages.
Priya (Eng): Can we include a short line in public FAQs about when Private deployment is recommended? customers ask often.
Claire (CEO): FAQ suggested line: "Private is recommended when you require customer-managed networking, on-premises deployment, or strict regulatory isolation."
Noah (Head of GTM): Competitor question: sales asks for a one-liner to explain how we're different from managed endpoint vendors. Any neutral phrasing?
Raj (VP Product): Use: "We pair a high-performance inference runtime with built-in rollouts, tracing, and cost controls for production apps" — avoids naming others.
Zara (Product Marketing): Also hearing from partners about APAC availability wording. Should marketing say "available in select APAC regions" or "coming soon"?
Claire (CEO): Say "growing APAC presence; select regions live." We'll be specific per-region in the infra docs.
ops-bot: Slides & recording: https://redwood-inference.slides/ah-2053334444 :white_check_mark:
Noah (Head of GTM): Timeline check: When will marketing get the updated priority bullets and FAQ lines?
Raj (VP Product): I'll post final copy in 5 business days. Engineering will review the tech blurbs before benchmarks go live.
Claire (CEO): Thanks all 1. Small ask: keep "predictable inference economics" phrase in the header options.
Zara (Product Marketing): Got it 1. Will sync in #marketing when drafts are ready.
thread_text_summary: Leadership Q&A follow-up listing three strategic priorities, guidance on outcome-first messaging, a Private deployment FAQ line, neutral competitor positioning, APAC availability wording, timelines for marketing copy, and action owners.
